title: hesperanthes scabrella
intro: Hesperanthes scabrella, commonly known as the fringe piper, is a type of orchid found in the United States. It is known for its unique, drooping flowers and its ability to thrive in a variety of environments. The fringe piper has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Hesperanthes scabrella include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
